minMCharsH.source: Render pacing (game-design choice, not a real-world figure): lowest served rate on the logarithmic pulse scale, about one seed customer's demand

maxMCharsH.source: Render pacing (game-design choice, not a real-world figure): served rate at which the pulse scale saturates, about 10 GTX 1080 Ti serving at 40 M chars/h each

minCyclesPerS.source: Render pacing (game-design choice): sentences per real second drawn at the bottom of the scale

maxCyclesPerS.source: Render pacing (game-design choice): sentences per real second drawn at the top of the scale, still readable

cyclesPerP100eq.source: Render pacing (game-design choice): training steps per real second drawn per effective P100-equivalent

minCyclesPerS.source: Render pacing (game-design choice): slowest drawn training step rate

maxCyclesPerS.source: Render pacing (game-design choice): fastest drawn training step rate, still readable
